revisions.summary: Initial set: AGENTS.md (plugin, build, conventions regions), .claude/CLAUDE.md and settings.json, manifest.json, .gitignore, .asciidoctorconfig, LICENSE, README.md.

AGENTS.md build region: no longer claims the repo has no build tooling, and the class-table command loads the sibling BASE BMM with -d (new variable base_bmm_schema_id); a TODO(scaffold) marker asks new repos to describe their own tooling. .claude/CLAUDE.md says where repo guidance goes.

A new repository gets computable/BMM/<id>.bmm.json: a copy of the schema the bmm-publisher image bundles for the component, or an empty schema (one root package, BASE included) when it bundles none. Existing repositories are not offered one. AGENTS.md sends BMM edits to the bmm-authoring skill.

README.md: a root README.adoc is no longer accepted in its place; the plan reports it as convert (rewrite it as Markdown, or merge it into an existing README.md). The bmm file is never offered to the ITS-XML, ITS-BMM, ITS-JSON and ITS-REST repositories, and bmm_schema_id must be empty there. AGENTS.md loads every schema the BMM includes with -d (bmm_dependencies, read from its includes), not BASE alone; base_bmm_schema_id is now derived from it.

component.description: Component id, as in manifest.json `id` (BASE, RM, ITS-REST).

component_title.description: Formal component name, for example 'Base Model'.

component_description.description: One-line description used by manifest.json and README.md.

jira_project.description: Jira project key of the component's change requests (SPECBASE, SPECRM). Not derivable for hyphenated ids: ITS-REST uses SPECITS.

jira_open_issues.description: Jira filter id of the open-issues list (manifest.json jira.open_issues); empty until it exists.

first_release.description: Id of the first release entry in manifest.json. Planning and Development use 0.y.z (see skill governance).

published_url.description: Where the rendered specifications are published.

default_branch.description: Default branch of the repository (master in every existing specifications-* repo).

license.description: Licence: cc-by-sa-3.0 for the AsciiDoc specifications, apache-2.0 for the ITS-* technical artefacts.

bmm_schema_id.description: BMM schema id (openehr_base_1.3.0) of computable/BMM/<id>.bmm.json, read from the repo. When a new repository is initialised without one: the highest schema the bmm-publisher image bundles for the component, else openehr_<component>_<first_release> for a new empty schema. Empty otherwise. Switches on the class-generation sections. Always empty in the ITS-XML, ITS-BMM, ITS-JSON and ITS-REST repositories.

bmm_dependencies.description: Schema ids loaded with -d when the class tables are regenerated, comma-separated: BASE first for every component but BASE (the version the BMM includes, else the highest in the sibling specifications-BASE clone), then each other schema its includes name, from the sibling clone of that component (openehr_lang_1.1.0 from specifications-LANG). Read from the repo on every run. Empty for BASE and without a BMM.

base_bmm_schema_id.description: The BASE schema among bmm_dependencies, which a new empty schema includes; empty without one.

bmm_schema_name.description: schema_name of the BMM schema (base in openehr_base_1.3.0); empty without one.

bmm_rm_release.description: rm_release of the BMM schema (1.3.0 in openehr_base_1.3.0); empty without one.

documents.description: Published document ids, read from manifest.json when present.
